name: Forg

sources.title: Homepage — 'Share your first project in seconds'; free to post; weekly Launchpad; Pro adds cross-posting/scheduling; Premium adds verification + announcement

requirements: Account/profile required — 'Create Profile' routes through /login; founder profile lives at forg.to/@you
Free tier covers posting updates, articles, and launching a project on the weekly Launchpad
Pro features: scheduling + cross-posting to X/LinkedIn/Bluesky; 'Premium' adds project verification and announcement
Audience is builders/founders — positioned as a build-in-public network, not a pure directory
preparation: Product name, URL, logo, short description
Founder profile details (stack, links, build history)
Optional RSS hookup if you want your Forg timeline on your own changelog page
workflow: Create a profile via https://forg.to/login ('Create Profile' → forg.to/@you)
Use 'Add Product' to share the project
Publish updates/articles; weekly Launchpad gives launch-week feedback
Optionally upgrade to Pro for cross-posting or Premium for verification
watchFor: The batch's /product/new URL was not verified — entry point is 'Add Product' after login
Visibility is activity-driven ('the more you ship, the more visible you become') — a single dormant listing has little value
Ads product exists ('Introducing Forg Ads') — paid placements compete in feed
~2k active users — small community compared to Product Hunt
countsAsLive: The project appears under forg.to /projects (or on your @you profile) with a public project page
unknowns: Whether profile/project outbound links are dofollow
